testPolicy.text: Brown requires SAT or ACT scores for first-year applicants (superscored; essay/writing optional; ACT Science optional since spring 2025). CDS C8F: required for all first-year students except first-year veterans applying via the veteran application.

gpa.doc: CDS 2025-2026, C11-C12: 'Brown does not collect GPA' (C10: 93% in top tenth of class, 29% submitted rank)

cost.totalIncludes: Incoming first-year full-time student: tuition 74,568 + fees 3,084 (includes 100 academic record fee for first-time students) + housing 10,710 + food 8,754 (direct charges 97,116) + miscellaneous personal 2,878. Books are not a separate line (most scholarship students are in a book/course materials program); travel not included.

aidPromise.text: Need-blind admission and 100 percent of demonstrated need met; The Brown Promise eliminates packaged loans from all undergraduate aid offers (100% of aided students have no loans in their packages); $0 parent contribution for most families with less than $60,000 in annual income.

facts.text: Early Decision is a large advantage: for fall 2025, 907 of 5,062 Early Decision applicants were admitted (17.9%), against 1,803 of the other 37,712 applicants (4.8%).
For the Class of 2030 (fall 2026), Brown received 47,944 applications and admitted 2,687 (5.6%), 889 of them through Early Decision.
Brown does not collect high school GPA; 93% of fall 2025 enrollees who reported a class rank were in the top tenth of their class.
Rhode Island residents are a tiny pool: 63 of 559 in-state applicants were admitted for fall 2025, against 2,243 of 32,351 other US applicants and 404 of 9,861 international applicants.
The 2026-27 cost of attendance for an incoming first-year is $99,994, and The Brown Promise means no loans are packaged in aid offers.
Brown admitted 295 students from its waiting list for fall 2025.

notes: Brown publishes its CDS only as a Tableau dashboard (linked from https://oir.brown.edu/institutional-data/common-data-set); C-section figures were read on screen in Chrome (tab C - Admissions, year 2025-2026), G-section values cross-checked via the Tableau CSV export (G-Expenses: housing 10,710, food 8,754, other 2,878). Waitlist offered/accepted are N/A in the CDS. Class of 2030 figures are from the admission office page, not a CDS. Brown's tuition-aid page also links 'New Student Tuition and Fees for the 2025-2026 Academic Year' but the finaid cost page gives 2026-27, which is used. I did not find on Brown pages opened a statement about need-aware treatment of international applicants or a $200,000 tuition-free tier, so neither is claimed. ED/RD split computed from CDS C21 counts. Accessed 2026-10-13.
